title: Large personal Amiga and DOS recovered-engine continuation discovery
summary: Personally screen 572 candidate URLs and add 20 projects, with four explicit non-promotion decisions.
notes: Root assistant personally continued the screened discovery list with four targeted Amiga/ST/CPC searches and a canonical-owner lookup, then inspected 23 repositories. This pass adds 20 implemented game/script/source-restoration records and records four identity/scope/architecture non-promotions. Fresh qualifying results concentrate on Amiga/DOS; tool-only search hits are not used to pad the batch. Native game code, hardware/data adapters, original game-script VMs and generated machine-instruction runtimes remain distinct. Renamed SkyNET identity is resolved through its stable GitHub repository ID; older Restunts history is not counted twice. Upstream replay, exactness and playable claims were not independently rerun; no asset fetcher, candidate code or game executed.

sources.reason: Native Settlers engine models serf state machines, economy and map simulation while reading DOS or Amiga resource sets.
Continues David Wang’s Dune Dynasty on OpenDUNE’s recovered engine, adding modern rendering, controls, skirmish/multiplayer and optional gameplay changes.
nukeykt reconstruction of Redneck Rampage/Rides Again, originating as a Rednukem subproject and retaining related Duke/Build-engine source lineage.
Translates disassembled Master of Magic routines into native code with overlay-linked function references and recovered economy, city and AI systems.
Disassembled DOS Syndicate engine replaces platform-specific services with SDL, OpenAL and WildMIDI interfaces.
Builds on street-rod-sdl3’s recovered SR.EXE core with separately marked enhanced road rendering, interpolation and launcher options.
C renderer/gameplay and sequencer recovery support original SkyRoads, Xmas Special and track-editor functionality with SDL host services.
Rust workspace recovers original formats, game state, demo input and renderer/audio paths with DOSBox tracing support.
Native cold boot and recovered routines run from asset files and retained boot constants without PRE2.EXE or runtime CPU execution; dos_re remains separate oracle/workbench.
Portable C engine reconstructs Supaplex with original-data tables and animation/game behavior, building on speed-fix reverse-engineering lineage.
Annotated assembly/IDA materials reconstruct and explain the previously unpublished Supaplex speed-fix executable.
Canonical project combines compilable original/patched disassembly, progressively ported C routines and replay-state dump tools for Stunts 1.1.
Extends Restunts with native C DOS/SDL3 paths, original-assembly reference and replay verification, retaining explicit legacy-width arithmetic rather than a universal CPU interpreter.
Portable game code and platform services build on nukeykt’s reverse-engineered Raptor Call of the Shadows engine.
Focused recovered rendering and collision snippets accompany explanations of the original Duke 1 engine.
Organizes decompiled Sierra AGI game/demo logic with named variables/controllers and WinAGI project material.
Pascal source port restores original Greed game/renderer systems with modern Windows presentation, input and interpolation changes.
Reworks Buzz Aldrin’s Race into Space original released code, preserving game systems while replacing historical host integration.
Godot reimplements XnGine shooter rules and data decoding, including mission scripts, movers, destructibles, vehicles and game flow.
Reconstructs engine/data systems for French 1.08 and US 1.23 Crusader with address-linked tables and SDL2 presentation, plus optional controls/rendering enhancements.
Older Restunts repository has same project/source identity. The current 4d-stunts README explicitly names its canonical repository; promote that instead of double-counting this history.

README explicitly combines idiomatic C++ with generated virtual-machine translation of remaining routines. Retain for game-specific emulation audit, not present as a fully native source reconstruction.
GitHub stable repository ID 1366805205 resolves to renamed owner nautilusbits/skynet-godot. Canonical project reviewed and promoted; old path is an alias, not missing or separate software.

Substantial released-source preservation project, but inspected primary material does not establish a DOS original and public platform catalogues identify Windows. Defer to a Windows-focused pass rather than mislabel as DOS.

build.narrative: C++20/SDL2 and owned supported-version resources required. Work in progress; PortMaster, other versions and No Regret remain planned. No full parity or runtime test performed.
build.limitations: Read-only source review; no upstream build, game, image or firmware execution. Upstream success statements remain attributed rather than independently verified.

runtime_profiles.narrative: No independent minimum CPU/RAM/chipset compatibility test was performed; hardware and format limitations remain qualified in build notes.

ai.narrative: README explicitly links continuing implementation work to renewal of the author’s Claude subscription; actual Claude-assisted development is attributed upstream.

relationships.narrative: Independent No Remorse recovery, not a claim that Pentagram or future sequel support is complete.

decisions.title: FreeSerf — Settlers engine reimplementation
decisions.reason: Native Settlers engine models serf state machines, economy and map simulation while reading DOS or Amiga resource sets.

decisions.title: Dune Dynasty — OpenDUNE-derived enhancement continuation
decisions.reason: Continues David Wang’s Dune Dynasty on OpenDUNE’s recovered engine, adding modern rendering, controls, skirmish/multiplayer and optional gameplay changes.

decisions.title: Redneck Rampage and Rides Again — reconstructed source
decisions.reason: nukeykt reconstruction of Redneck Rampage/Rides Again, originating as a Rednukem subproject and retaining related Duke/Build-engine source lineage.

decisions.title: ReMoM — Master of Magic engine reconstruction
decisions.reason: Translates disassembled Master of Magic routines into native code with overlay-linked function references and recovered economy, city and AI systems.

decisions.title: SyndicatFX — native x86 Syndicate restoration
decisions.reason: Disassembled DOS Syndicate engine replaces platform-specific services with SDL, OpenAL and WildMIDI interfaces.

decisions.title: Street Rod Enhanced — reconstructed core and modern view
decisions.reason: Builds on street-rod-sdl3’s recovered SR.EXE core with separately marked enhanced road rendering, interpolation and launcher options.

decisions.title: SkyRoads SDL — game, Xmas edition and editor port
decisions.reason: C renderer/gameplay and sequencer recovery support original SkyRoads, Xmas Special and track-editor functionality with SDL host services.

decisions.title: SkyRoads Codex — partial native Rust reconstruction
decisions.reason: Rust workspace recovers original formats, game state, demo input and renderer/audio paths with DOSBox tracing support.

decisions.title: Prehistorik 2 — recovered Python native runtime
decisions.reason: Native cold boot and recovered routines run from asset files and retained boot constants without PRE2.EXE or runtime CPU execution; dos_re remains separate oracle/workbench.

decisions.title: OpenSupaplex — portable recovered game engine
decisions.reason: Portable C engine reconstructs Supaplex with original-data tables and animation/game behavior, building on speed-fix reverse-engineering lineage.

decisions.title: Supaplex SPFIX63 — speed-fix disassembly
decisions.reason: Annotated assembly/IDA materials reconstruct and explain the previously unpublished Supaplex speed-fix executable.

decisions.title: Restunts — canonical Stunts reconstruction
decisions.reason: Canonical project combines compilable original/patched disassembly, progressively ported C routines and replay-state dump tools for Stunts 1.1.

decisions.title: Chocolate Stunts — Restunts-derived native continuation
decisions.reason: Extends Restunts with native C DOS/SDL3 paths, original-assembly reference and replay verification, retaining explicit legacy-width arithmetic rather than a universal CPU interpreter.

decisions.title: Raptor — recovered-engine portable continuation
decisions.reason: Portable game code and platform services build on nukeykt’s reverse-engineered Raptor Call of the Shadows engine.

decisions.title: Duke Nukem 1 — matching engine-routine studies
decisions.reason: Focused recovered rendering and collision snippets accompany explanations of the original Duke 1 engine.

decisions.title: Sierra AGI — recovered logic-script archive
decisions.reason: Organizes decompiled Sierra AGI game/demo logic with named variables/controllers and WinAGI project material.

decisions.title: xGreed — In Pursuit of Greed source continuation
decisions.reason: Pascal source port restores original Greed game/renderer systems with modern Windows presentation, input and interpolation changes.

decisions.title: Race into Space — released-source game restoration
decisions.reason: Reworks Buzz Aldrin’s Race into Space original released code, preserving game systems while replacing historical host integration.

decisions.title: SkyNET and Future Shock — frozen Godot recovery
decisions.reason: Godot reimplements XnGine shooter rules and data decoding, including mission scripts, movers, destructibles, vehicles and game flow.

decisions.title: Crusader No Remorse — recovered C++ engine
decisions.reason: Reconstructs engine/data systems for French 1.08 and US 1.23 Crusader with address-linked tables and SDL2 presentation, plus optional controls/rendering enhancements.

decisions.title: xor2003/restunts
decisions.reason: Older Restunts repository has same project/source identity. The current 4d-stunts README explicitly names its canonical repository; promote that instead of double-counting this history.

decisions.title: zlatkok/swos-port
decisions.reason: README explicitly combines idiomatic C++ with generated virtual-machine translation of remaining routines. Retain for game-specific emulation audit, not present as a fully native source reconstruction.

decisions.title: nemo22/skynet-godot
decisions.reason: GitHub stable repository ID 1366805205 resolves to renamed owner nautilusbits/skynet-godot. Canonical project reviewed and promoted; old path is an alias, not missing or separate software.

decisions.title: signus-game/signus
decisions.reason: Substantial released-source preservation project, but inspected primary material does not establish a DOS original and public platform catalogues identify Windows. Defer to a Windows-focused pass rather than mislabel as DOS.
